notes.title: Update September 23
notes.content: Touchpad for main teletransportation for other Windows Mixed reality devices

notes.title: Updates for September 20
notes.content: A visual effect has been added to guide you toward the objective: the nuclear bomb. Gameplay changes have been made to the level "The Bridge"

notes.title: Updates for September 14
notes.content: Visual effects have been improved a lot. Now the player starts each level with a weapon ready. Also some bug fixes.

notes.title: Update Note from Nov 03
notes.content:
Added a way to return to the main menu at the start of each level
New gameplay for the level The City
Changes to the main menu and description from what the mission is in the extraction point
Changes to the AI, now the enemies are more aggressive and fastest
